defects.title: The prescribed exactly-once execution cannot write its result and crashes AFTER computing the target
detail: evidence/execution_r1/ does not exist at 179d5aae and cannot exist in a clean checkout of any freeze commit unless a file is committed there (git does not track empty directories).

main() never creates out.parent and never checks it; out.write_text runs only after verify_freeze, git_state, load_sources, extract_inputs, g/t/b for every m and assemble. With the directory absent it raises an uncaught FileNotFoundError (not a K4R1Refusal): G, T, B are computed in memory, nothing is recorded or printed, and the exactly-once is consumed with no record (any retry is a second execution).

GATE.execution mixes a namespace-relative script path (code/k4r1_certificate.py) with a repo-relative --out (level4/...). Run literally from the repo root, the script is not found; run from the namespace directory, --out resolves to <ns>/level4/closure_proofs/... and the run again crashes after computing, even if evidence/execution_r1 was pre-created.
The e2e harness masks this: build_repo mkdirs evidence/execution_r1 and run_execute passes an absolute path in-process.
